limitations: One real Desktop frontend source copy; six repeated cycles are not independent applications or customers.
Only the signed-out root landing, theme roundtrip, modal tab rendering and close are exercised.
No authentication attempts, bypass, rate-limit/load test, real credentials or API service.
No robot program generation, backend jobs, AI providers, files, hardware, export or authenticated admin/editor workflows.
No cross-document theme persistence test; no reload during memory measurement.
API, external-origin, non-GET/HEAD requests and all WebSockets are blocked and counted, never fulfilled as a fake success.
